Rule text: A red-first, pre-registered MB-27.L2 item stores principal roof_slope_max as unregulated by absence: in RD, RS, RM and RT (no slope article; M-361 Q1), for every class; in R, for the classes 10.10.40.10(4) does not name: detached_houseplex, semi_detached_house, semi_detached_houseplex (Spec 68 rule 7a v2). R detached_house and house_with_secondary_suite keep 5:3. It rides the increment-2 roof-axis night with McProof item 1 (same mechanism, "item 1 A"). If it moves the frozen bylaw-eval-perf corpus, it waits for MB-79 (f) with item 1. Answer-key values are unchanged (they already assumed no cap). Examples reading the cell are marked "inputs pending reload". Not offered: an R3-01/M-461 exception path (no-exception-paths rule).

decisions.question: M-484: the 1:4 roof test of the RD Chapter 900 exceptions is keyed as the design-choice token flat_or_shallow_roof (the 1:4 re-key sub-task).
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "D-RK"; ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/MB-27L2/CARD-1in4-rekey.v2.md): "D-RK a". Rule text: The 29 RD 1:4 exceptions are re-keyed as their own MB-27.L2 (1:4) sub-task, landing before the axis night: each 1:4 unit's condition.tokens gains flat_or_shallow_roof (69(C) keeps storey_count_band); the token's patterns gain the 1:4 wording; the thresholds table gains 0.25; its own prereg; a CoA move check; an oracle-class sweep in a throwaway clone; its own push. If the sweep shows a frozen oracle moves, it goes through the MB-79 (f) door. Storage ~1 MiB. Reading (i) was settled by O-A a (the four "flat roof" clauses take the zone's 1:10). Reading (ii) remains open.

decisions.question: M-484: reading (ii) of the 1:4 card: on the re-keyed lots the pitched option is taken at a slope of at least 1:4 and the middle band is not evaluated.
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "1:4 card reading (ii)", pasting option (a)): "approved". Rule text: Reading (ii) option (a): on the 29 re-keyed RD 1:4 exception lots, the pitched design option is taken at a slope ≥ 1:4; the middle band (1:10 to 1:4) is shown not_evaluated with its reason and the headline flagged headline_lower_bound (Q-HEAD B). No extra storage. This answer is the ruling for the departure from M-400 (one option left unstored on those lots). Never over-reports.
